name: Cosmic Commandos
caption: A laser-and-pyro gimmick tag team who won the federation's own 1 April 1996 return show over the Gershwin Brothers.

name: The Gershwin Brothers
caption: A musician-gimmick tag team who lost the federation's own 1 April 1996 return show to the Cosmic Commandos.

name: Triple Threat
caption: A managed stable of EWC wrestlers under Tamara; two of its three members wrestled and won on the federation's own 1 April 1996 return show.
notes: A third member is billed but not named in this collection's own held record; not invented here.

identity.note: The same billing exists in other wings; this entity was minted from its own federation's 1997 documents with no receipt joining it to those — held distinct under the no-auto-merge-and-no-silent-distinctness rule; reopenable on a shared-handler or cross-fed receipt.
